description: Main window capability. http is scoped to the pairing surfaces only (ts.net home serves over Tailscale HTTPS, loopback for dev and USB) — the packaged app talks to nothing else. barcode-scanner and notification are registered for their later UI chunks. secure-storage plugin commands are deliberately NOT granted to JS: the token_get/token_set/token_del commands in lib.rs are the only door to the token.
